errorCodes.meaning: The filter carried no constraint the maintainer can scan on. An unconstrained query would enumerate the consumer's whole vault, so it is refused rather than answered. `includeArchived` and `includeDeleted` are modifiers and do not satisfy this requirement on their own.

graceUntil.description: Present iff `lifecycle` is `deleted`. Restorable while now < graceUntil.

id.description: Local handle. Opaque to the consumer; the id `get`, `archive`, `delete` and the rest are keyed on.

lifecycle.description: Omitted for active credentials, so an active-only result is unchanged by this member's existence.

types.description: VC `type` tags carried by the credential.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.

schema.description: A filtered, body-free search over stored credentials. At least one of `type`, `communityDid`, `issuerDid`, `purpose` or `status` MUST be present — see the specification; `includeArchived` and `includeDeleted` are modifiers and do not satisfy that requirement.

communityDid.description: Match credentials held for this community or context DID.

includeArchived.description: Modifier, not a filter: also return archived credentials matching the other constraints. Absent means false.

includeDeleted.description: Modifier, not a filter: also return soft-deleted tombstones matching the other constraints. Absent means false.

issuerDid.description: Match credentials issued by this DID.

purpose.description: Match the maintainer's semantic classification of the credential.

subjectDid.description: Narrow the other constraints to credentials whose subject — the DID a presentation of the credential is made as — is this DID. Narrows only: it does not satisfy the at-least-one-filter requirement on its own.

type.description: Match credentials carrying this VC `type` tag.

schema.title: Vault Credentials — Query
